tweet_pool.author: ItsmeAjayKV
tweet_pool.text: Xiaomi just showed its AI Cube Prototype and this could become a serious GB10 competitor from China - 3 custom chips: Xring O3, O100, D100 - 200 TOPS NPU - 1.22 TB/s AI memory bandwidth - Up to 160GB unified memory - 150W sustained power - 120B models running locally
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete China local-AI hardware release with detailed specs.

tweet_pool.author: Apodex_AI
tweet_pool.text: Meet Apodex 1.1: Scaling Agentic Intelligence for Complex Work. Open Source Harness on GitHub, Open Weights on Hugging Face.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Open-source agentic model family release with weights and harness.

tweet_pool.author: andykonwinski
tweet_pool.text: Introducing Headlong, an open source microharness for persistent agents: self-guided agents that think continuously. Most agent harnesses are reactive; Headlong keeps agents thinking between tasks.

tweet_pool.author: vllm_project
tweet_pool.text: Congratulations to SemiAnalysis on the release of AgentX 1.0, an open-source multi-turn agentic coding benchmark collected from ~$3M of real traces, running on 1000+ chips and ~2MW of continuously operated compute.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Open-source agentic coding benchmark release from real production traces.

tweet_pool.author: theinformation
tweet_pool.text: Nvidia is giving away its AI models for free. The idea is that if more people can access affordable, fine-tunable open-source models, they will want more compute and buy more Nvidia.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Company strategy: Nvidia open-model giveaway tied to compute demand.

tweet_pool.text: Alabama Attorney General Steve Marshall has issued a subpoena demanding OpenAI respond to an investigation into the company's 'complete lack of oversight and adequate safeguards' in the Hugging Face incident.

tweet_pool.author: thsottiaux
tweet_pool.text: OpenAI DevDay 2026 will be our best DevDay in the history of the company. It will not be close.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: OpenAI leadership signalling on upcoming DevDay 2026.

tweet_pool.author: MTSlive
tweet_pool.text: Mathematician Elliot Glazer argues automating pure math may look surprisingly similar to automating deep learning research: machine learning is more empirical than pure math.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Substantive analysis on automating mathematics vs ML research.

tweet_pool.author: alex_verem
tweet_pool.text: Your desktop, laptop, and old rig can run one AI model together. The models worth running keep outgrowing normal hardware; distributed local inference across owned machines is an alternative to renting cloud GPUs.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Practitioner analysis on distributed local model inference.

tweet_pool.author: mattpocockuk
tweet_pool.text: A great loop idea: database alerts you to a slow query, opens an issue in your codebase, schedules a PR from an implementer agent, a reviewer agent reviews it, then pings the human for review. Repeat until the app is fast.

tweet_pool.author: fnruji316625
tweet_pool.text: Why does Muon outperform Adam in LLM training? An ICLR 2026 paper offers an answer through associative memory: Muon is particularly effective at learning rare, tail-end knowledge from heavy-tailed data.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete ICLR 2026 paper on optimiser behaviour in LLM training.

tweet_pool.author: RossHudgens
tweet_pool.text: Perplexity's market share is shrinking, from around 1.9% to about 1% and trending lower, argument for removing it from LLM trackers.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Market-share data point on Perplexity vs other assistants.

tweet_pool.author: rickasaurus
tweet_pool.text: No one is going to pay you 750K if you can build a basic LLM, that ship sailed two years ago.

tweet_pool.author: theallinpod
tweet_pool.text: David Sacks predicts an open-source AI ban is coming via regulatory capture.

tweet_pool.author: rohanpaul_ai
tweet_pool.text: There is no wall. AI can combine and synthesize specialized expert knowledge across fields - Dario Amodei, from Lex Fridman's podcast.
